title: Long Public Debate on City Budget
summary:
*   A special meeting was entirely dedicated to a public hearing on the city's operating budget and fees for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   Citizens had the opportunity to provide their input regarding the proposed budget and associated city fees.
*   The public hearing was a lengthy session, lasting over six hours, before its conclusion.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - August 22, 1988 - 4:00 P.M Council Chambers, 307 V\fcst Second
Street, Austin. Texas Mayor Cooke called the meeting to order, noting the presence of all
Councilmembers.
Mayor Cook* stated that the purpose of the meeting was to hold a public hearing on the
operating budget and fees for FY 1988-89.
Mayor Cooke then opened the hearing to members of the audience. Individuals who spoke have
cards on file in the City Clerk's Office.
At the conclusion of the hearing, on Councilmerober Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember
Urdy's second, the
Council closed the hearing. (7-0.vote)
ADJOURNMENT
The Council adjourned at 10:40 p.m.
